review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T022. The evidence decision lives in docs/standard. Both combinations and their uncertainties are inherited from the published analyses.

question: Are the Michelson-Morley (orientation) and Kennedy-Thorndike (velocity) combinations of the two-way speed of light consistent with zero, as the Lorentz boost of the parent action's local frame requires (wave O8)?

output.quantity: P_MM and P_KT with their uncertainties
output.domain: laboratory at about 370 km/s relative to the CMB frame

model.assumptions: Lorentzian local frame of the parent action; light and resonator matter couple to the same metric.
model.approximation: Robertson-Mansouri-Sexl kinematics to order v^2; resonator response handled upstream.
model.initial_boundary: Laboratory velocity relative to the CMB frame as used in the published analyses.

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Results seen before drafting (exposure SEEN_FULL), declared in Test Card T022.

system_partition.boundary: Published RMS combinations and their uncertainties only.

systems.state: Optical and microwave resonators moving with the Earth relative to the CMB frame

state_accounting.rule: Resonance frequency of a cavity as a function of orientation and velocity.

observables.backaction_scope_reason: The populations are the only assessed owner.
observables.quantity: P_MM and P_KT with their uncertainties

observation.source_state: As described by the published analyses.
observation.generated_trace: Resonance frequencies of cavities and oscillators.
observation.readout: Beat frequencies between orthogonal or rotating cavities, and between a sapphire oscillator and hydrogen masers.
observation.frame: Laboratory frame and the CMB frame

components.reason: Two-way light speed in resonators versus orientation and velocity.

60-digit arithmetic for the model value; covered by physics tests (model error below 1e-20).

error_budget.numerical: Model in 60-digit arithmetic; the first run in 64-bit floats failed on rounding (Test Card T022, amendment 1).
error_budget.approximation: Combinations to order v^2, as in the source analyses.
error_budget.systematic: Rotation, tilt, temperature and maser systematics are in the published budgets.
error_budget.omissions: Sign conventions of the papers are not converted; only the distance from zero enters.
error_budget.acceptance: Outcome categories fixed in Test Card T022.

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T022 comparison only. The evidence level is set in docs/standard.
next_action: Cross-check the transcribed combinations against the journal versions.
